power_supply_scheme.document: STMicroelectronics STM32H743xI datasheet, DocID030538 Rev 3 (October 2017), served by LCSC for C114408
power_supply_scheme.shows: Figure 13, Power supply scheme, with each decoupling value against the pin it belongs to: VDD gets N x 100 nF plus one 4.7 uF where N is the package's VDD pin count, VCAP 2 x 2.2 uF, VDDLDO 4.7 uF, VDDA 100 nF + 1 uF, VREF+ 100 nF + 1 uF, and VDD33USB and VDD50USB 100 nF each
